template: In Grafana at http://127.0.0.1:3000, do a final verification of the dashboard titled '{{v1}}'. Navigate to it fresh (full page load, e.g. via search or by going to {{v3}} with no query params). Then verify and report ALL of the following from the live page: (1) the exact dashboard title shown in the breadcrumb/page, (2) the exact titles of all panels on the dashboard and their types (one should be a Stat panel titled '{{v6}}' using the TestData data source, one a Text panel titled '{{v7}}' whose content contains '{{v2}}'), (3) the dashboard's tags (open Dashboard settings → General if needed) — should include '{{05-open.persisted_tags}}', (4) the persisted default time range (Dashboard settings → JSON Model: the top-level 'time' object) — should be from {{06-open.json_model_time_from}} to {{06-open.json_model_time_to}}, (5) the persisted auto-refresh (JSON Model top-level 'refresh') — should be '1m', and (6) the exact URL currently shown in the browser address bar for this dashboard page. Report each item with the concrete value you read.

reportTemplate.summary: Full-load verification of "{{v1}}" (loaded with no query params; Grafana normalised the address bar itself). On the live page the breadcrumb reads Home / Dashboards / "{{v1}}" (@e53, exact title "{{v1}}"), and exactly two panels render: a Text panel titled "{{v7}}" whose rendered body is "Bench notes for run {{v2}}" (contains "{{v2}}"), and a Stat panel titled "{{v6}}" (rendered value 78.2 on this load, datasource TestData uid "benchtestdata" per the JSON model). Dashboard settings → General/JSON Model (read from the live Monaco editor contents) shows tags ["bench"], title "{{v1}}", and the JSON Model's top-level fields: "refresh": "1m" and "time": {"from":"now-6h","to":"now"}. The top bar also shows "Last 6 hours" and refresh interval "1m".

values.topbar_refresh_interval: 1m (button 'Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected')
